text: YI Zhan-miao12∗ ZHAI Suo-di1＃（1．Dept．of PharmacyThe Third Hospital of Peking UniversityBeijing 100191China；2．School of Pharmaceutical SciencesPeking UniversityBeijing100191China）ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE：To discuss the correlation between smoking and drugs for references of clinical rational drug use．METHODS：The pertinent literature at home and abroad were reviewed and analyzed．RESULTS：Smoking interacts with drugs in both pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics．CONCLUSION：Clinicians should attach great importance to the interaction between smoking and drugs to ensure medication safety卫生部年月日公布的第四次国家卫生服务调查结果显示我国岁及以上人口男性吸烟率为女性吸烟率为由此推算我国现时吸烟人口有亿［1］而全世界约有十几亿吸烟者占全球成年人总数的四分之一其中大多数都已对烟草成瘾［2］ 。曾经有调查显示在实际观察和实验的种不同的药物中有种药物与吸烟有相互作用吸烟引起的药物相互作用比率为33∙3％［3］ 。因此在临床中使用药物时针对吸烟的患者应该充分考虑吸烟对药物作用的影响以便及时调整用药途径及药物的剂量。
